The association

About the association

The Student Chopin Competition EPFL-UNIL aims to promote classical music and support young talent within university student communities. We believe in the importance of art for personal development and social cohesion. The association is run by student volunteers, united by their love of music.

Our mission

To create a unique environment for student pianists that fosters their artistic development and visibility.

Our values

Excellence, passion, sharing and accessibility.

Our vision

To become a must-attend musical event in Switzerland, known for the quality of its young talent.

Our main projects

The Student Chopin Competition

Every year, student pianists are pre-selected on video and auditioned in front of a jury, and the best of them meet for a public final followed by the prize-giving. Born at EPFL/UNIL, the competition opened to ETH and the University of Zürich in 2026, with a joint Grand Final on 9 May 2026 at the EPFL Rolex Forum. The 2026-2027 edition also welcomes UNIGE (learn more), and a first Alumni Edition is planned for 2027.

The 2025 edition at a glance:

  • 10 pianists selected from more than 30 applicants
  • a full house for the final, with more than 300 spectators
  • interviews and a news item on RTS
  • a professional jury chaired by the Chopin Foundation of Geneva
  • for the podium: free access to the Chopin masterclasses and festival in Geneva, a masterclass with pianist Vincent Coq, and a concert at the Lavaux Classic festival for first place

Concerts on campus

Throughout the year, we organise free concerts on campus, often with HEMU students:

  • 24 April 2025: Epicea Edelweiss, Methodist Church, Lausanne
  • 27 November 2025: concert by a HEMU string quartet
  • 26 March 2026: MUG Trio (HEMU), "Ombre et lumière: la Russie romantique", UNIL
  • 25 April 2026: recital by Angela Yixuan Miao with Musical, Hall BC, EPFL
  • 29 October 2026: concert at UNIL
  • 3 December 2026, 7:15 pm: Ensemble Dyade (HEMU), Mozart and Brahms, room POL-164, UNIL (book, 45 seats)

Other initiatives

  • 22 September 2025: masterclass with pianist Vincent Coq
  • 8 November 2025: prize-giving at the final of the Lavaux Classic festival
